title: Income Taxes—Recovery of Revalued Non-Depreciable Assets
summary: Addressed how to measure deferred tax on revalued non-depreciable assets, confirming that the carrying amount would be recovered through sale. Withdrawn in 2012.

related.title: Income Taxes
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2010 amendments superseded SIC-21 by generalising the 'recovery through sale' presumption into a rebuttable presumption for investment property and other non-depreciable revalued assets

related.title: Property, Plant and Equipment
related.relationship: Supplies the revaluation model under which non-depreciable assets such as land may be carried at fair value, triggering the deferred tax question SIC-21 addressed
